newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trinkaus sees 97 profit up at least 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Trinkaus sees 97 profit up at least 10 pct.

text.p: Germany's Trinkaus & Burkhardt KGaA said on Wednesday it expected operating profit growth in 1997 would at least match the 10 percent rise achieved in the first six months.
Trinkaus sees 97 profit up at least 10 pct
"For the full year we expect growth to be at least as strong as in the first half," Trinkaus said.
Results for the first six months and for July justified the bank's upbeat outlook for the year, it said.
In the first six months of 1997, Trinkaus, a subsidiary of HSBC Holdings Plc, increased its operating profit after risk provisions by 9.9 percent to 85.3 million marks.
